Name: Blue Iridium
Author: vvillow
Description:
[size=3][color=#9fc5e8][center]feel like the purple of iridium is too harsh ? want your tools to look more neutral ? or just like the colour blue ? this mod is for you ![/center][/color]

[b]i have changed each item i could find that relates to iridium and edited it to blue, including:[/b][/size][list]
[*][b][size=3] [u]tools[/u] (watering can, hoe, axe, pickaxe and fishing rod)[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=3] [u]weapons[/u] (galaxy sword, galaxy hammer, galaxy dagger & galaxy slingshot, which is currently unobtainable ingame)[/size][/b]
[*][size=3][b] [u]buildings[/u] (slime hutch)[/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b] [u]misc[/u] (iridium bar, iridium sprinkler, meteorite, iridium band, slime egg press, slime incubator, space boots* and statue of perfection)[/b][/size]
[/list][size=2]
*the colour of the space boots has also been changed, so they will look blue on your farmer.[/size]

[size=3]to download, place each xnb file into the corresponding folder in your stardew valley content folders. don't forget to [/size][u]backup ![/u]
[u]NOTE: this mod is NOT compatible with other mods that change: shoeColors.xnb, SpringObjects.xnb, Craftables.xnb, Tools.xnb, Weapons.xnb, towninterior.xnb and slime hutch.xnb[/u]

[size=3]i have permission from Eemie to upload a compatibility file for her [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/687/?][color=#ea9999]Darker Wood Craftables[/color][/url], so download that if you wish to keep her mod installed along with mine !!


[/size]i'm not sure if i found every iridium item, so if you see something that is unedited - [b]please[/b] tell me !! thank you. i'm also happy to help anyone out with anything, hmu if u need to (-: check back occasionally in case i have found, edited and uploaded updated items.
[color=#cfe2f3][size=3][b][u]
EDIT:
[/u][/b][/size][/color] - added slime egg-press and incubator
 - added slime hutch
